name: Forte AUD
oneLiner: AUDF is Forte Securities Australia's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 with AUD reserves held separately.
collateral: Australian dollar reserves and cash-equivalent reserve assets held separately from Forte's operational funds
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for AUD through Forte Securities Australia Pty Ltd for eligible account holders to approved bank accounts, with monthly independent reserve audits and daily reserve monitoring

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: AUDF resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: AUDF uses a 2/5 Admin Safe that holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Avalanche; on Redbelly the Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE is currently unassigned (granting runs through the Safe). The Ethereum MINT_ROLE also has a second holder: a StablecoinMintBurnOFTAdapter contract owned by the same Safe. ProxyAdmin across chains is owned by the Admin Safe.

controls.label: AUDF Admin Safe (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINT_ROLE, multichain)
controls.evidence: Safe Transaction Service: 2/5 Safe, no modules, zero guard. Confirmed DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINT_ROLE on ETH via RoleGranted logs; same Safe confirmed on Polygon and Base via role logs; on Avalanche confirmed via hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returning true and hasRole(MINT_ROLE) returning true at latest block. ProxyAdmin on ETH (0x2dcafce3b4fc7aba1b822637b12d6156fc85edd9) owned by this Safe; same ProxyAdmin confirmed on Avalanche via proxy-admin EIP-1967 slot.

controls.label: AUDF Ethereum OFT adapter MINT_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Identified as StablecoinMintBurnOFTAdapter (LayerZero OFT cross-chain bridge adapter). owner() returned 0x6929Fd915b0755EfDC255eA841B68a263A362C5A — the Admin Safe. Upgrade and operational authority is therefore under the same 2/5 Safe.

controls.label: AUDF Polygon/Base EOA MINT_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: RoleGranted logs on Polygon and Base both show this EOA holding MINT_ROLE (role hash 0x22435ed...) alongside the Admin Safe. eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). This appears to be Forte's operational minting key.

review.evidence: 2/5 Admin Safe confirmed as DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINT_ROLE holder on ETH, Polygon, Base, and Avax. ProxyAdmin owned by the same Safe on ETH and Avax. OFT adapter (ETH MINT_ROLE) owned by Safe. Operational EOA minter 0xfd5d8237 confirmed on Polygon and Base; same EOA absent from Avax (Safe-only on Avax). Redbelly re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 3075429 via governors.mainnet.redbelly.network (now publicly reachable): the token reports the same uniform implementation 0xc9357d8fb84dd3041612dc5b2a2cd914d9405572 and proxy admin 0x2dcafce3b4fc7aba1b822637b12d6156fc85edd9; hasRole confirms the Admin Safe 0x6929Fd915b0755EfDC255eA841B68a263A362C5A holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on Redbelly while MINT_ROLE is held by neither the Safe, the operational EOA, nor the OFT adapter.
review.reviewer: Claude Phase 0c continuation; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-6 (lead usde-ethena)

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AUDF is integrated with LayerZero and Stargate for cross-chain interoperability. Because Stargate/LayerZero introduces external bridge and messaging infrastructure, Pharos scores AUDF as external lock/mint route exposure rather than native-only issuance.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-6 (lead usde-ethena)
